name: v1.6.0 — Pro Features, Collapsible Sections, 5 New Cards
notes: SwipeRight Pro launched (free now, paywall later): live card offers + bill payment comparison. Collapsible sections in My Cards & Library. Charges (forex markup, fuel waiver, cash advance) in card detail. 5 new cards (Samsung Axis Signature, SBI Cashback, SBI BPCL Octane, Tata Neu Infinity HDFC, Tata Neu Plus HDFC). 114 cards total.
